last_handoff.result: SESSION_OBJECTIVE: eliminate real-keyboard spatial-navigation instability while preserving real keyboard input, physics, collisions, interaction radii, canonical world semantics and existing timeout policy. CHECKPOINT 1: reconciled the previous exact-SHA evidence. Work SHA 4985f53c66722f2cf85ed9648be1652099c451f8 had Visual Forge, Windows, Release Reproducibility, Prototype Web CI and Playable Candidate green, plus two successful Stream Slice attempts, but Living World Integration remained red with browser navigation failures. CHECKPOINT 2: on 4c91d92efdb289511b8eed822a33aace22ff4817 moved interaction steering to a browser-frame feedback loop while retaining real Playwright keyboard down/up actuation; concurrent x/y steering now prevents one axis from consuming the shared navigation window, post-release coordinates drive corrections, and stall sensing uses elapsed no-progress time. No gameplay speed, collision, interaction radius, canonical state or global timeout changed. CHECKPOINT 3: fresh Stream Slice run 35028429319 on 4c91d92efdb289511b8eed822a33aace22ff4817 proved backend tests, preflight, 50 web contracts, production build and the human-control rehearsal green, then exposed a different boundary: the complete causal evening route was functionally progressing but the monolithic Playwright test exhausted its existing 180-second per-test budget on a slow runner. CHECKPOINT 4: on final work SHA 15b6e77b42af0e87ec82db2fc6f1eb9d973c9d2b split the causal evening acceptance into two serial persisted phases instead of increasing a timeout or bypassing gameplay. Phase one proves the physical Mira/Kaspar/tavern/Talen/Oren causal route through tick 10. Phase two starts a fresh browser page against the same persisted player/world, waits for real TavernScene readiness, performs the physical bread-delivery route, reloads and re-verifies causal knowledge. This preserves real controls and adds a stable browser-scene readiness boundary for reload navigation. CHECKPOINT 5: validation branch and PR #56 were fast-forwarded to the unchanged work SHA 15b6e77b42af0e87ec82db2fc6f1eb9d973c9d2b. Fresh exact-head PR evidence at handoff: Visual Forge Gate run 35029225620 success; Release Reproducibility Gate run 35029225815 success; Windows Compatibility Gate run 35029225686 success including full Python, Stream Slice preflight, web contracts/build, fresh SQLite/timezone and Windows backend/API boot. Stream Slice Gate run 35029225654 had backend install, profile Python tests, preflight, 50 contracts, build and Chromium installation green with Stream Slice Chromium acceptance still in progress. Living World Integration run 35029225615 had backend/persistence green and client contract/build green with the real browser route in progress. Playable Candidate run 35029225747 had backend/Living World green and web contract/build green with browser acceptance in progress. Prototype Web CI run 35029225640 had contracts/build/startup controls green with browser vertical slice in progress. STOP_REASON: EXECUTION_LIMIT. No owner decision is required.
